changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE assistant_query_log ( id UUID NOT NULL, organization_id BIGINT NOT NULL, project_id BIGINT NULL, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, question TEXT NOT NULL, resolved_scope JSONB NULL, providers_selected TEXT[] NULL, evidence_ids TEXT[] NULL, outcome VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, answer JSONB NULL, llm_model VARCHAR(200) NULL, llm_model_version VARCHAR(200) NULL, prompt_tokens INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, completion_tokens INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, embedding_tokens INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, estimated_cost_micros BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, latency_ms BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT pk_assistant_query_log PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT fk_assistant_query_log_organization FOREIGN KEY (organization_id) REFERENCES organization (id) )
